faq_heading: Cloverdale Retail Space for Sale: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Commercial figures are from GVR Commercial Edge (Q2 2026) and Avison Young (Q3 2026); zones are the municipal bylaw summaries on the zoning guide. For sale listings only.

Retail space for sale in Cloverdale: storefronts, retail strata units and retail buildings listed on the MLS®. For sale only; space for lease is not included. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 to ask about one of these, or about something not listed.

items.t: Cloverdale Town Centre is at Highway 10 and Highway 15. Council endorsed its plan on November 18, 2019 and an update on October 30, 2023 to support the planned new hospital and BC Cancer Centre. ([City of Surrey, Cloverdale Town Centre Plan](https://www.surrey.ca/renovating-building-development/land-planning-development/land-use-planning/cloverdale-land-use-plans/cloverdale-town-centre-plan), read November 20, 2026)

On July 22, 2024 the plan area was expanded north, adding roughly 80.8 hectares. ([City of Surrey, Cloverdale Town Centre Plan](https://www.surrey.ca/renovating-building-development/land-planning-development/land-use-planning/cloverdale-land-use-plans/cloverdale-town-centre-plan), read November 20, 2026)

blocks.text: In the second quarter of 2026, 12 of the 53 commercial sales in the City of Surrey were retail & other properties, against 82 across the Lower Mainland. Commercial Edge reports Surrey as one city, so the figure covers all of Surrey, not only Cloverdale.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).
City of Surrey zones that allow retail uses

Each zone links to its full summary on the zoning guide. These are municipal zones, so some apply to parts of Surrey outside Cloverdale. A zone that allows a use may still need a permit or a rezoning for a specific site, so check the address with the municipality before you buy.

faq.q: How many retail properties sold in Surrey recently?
faq.a: 12 in the second quarter of 2026, out of 53 commercial sales in the City of Surrey (GVR Commercial Edge).
